root.name: ライオット・プラットフォームズ

rows.ja: 競合(相手の資料に記載)

relations.text: 最新の液浸型マイニング機を長期で調達する基本契約(累計約7.8億ドル分を発注)
relations.text_en: Long-term master agreement for immersion miners; about $779.5 million ordered to date

source.label: Riot Platforms 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Through December 31, 2025, we executed purchase orders under the Master Agreement to acquire miners with a total hash rate of 49.2 EH/s, for a total purchase price of approximately $779.5 million.

relations.text: 保有ビットコインの保管を委託する2社のうちの一社
relations.text_en: One of two custodians holding its bitcoin

source.label: Riot Platforms 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Our bitcoin is held in cold storage wallets by well-known U.S.-based third-party digital asset-focused custodians, NYDIG Trust Company LLC ("NYDIG") and Coinbase, Inc.

relations.text: 保有ビットコインの保管を委託する2社のうちの一社
relations.text_en: One of two custodians holding its bitcoin

source.label: Riot Platforms 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Our bitcoin is held in cold storage wallets by well-known U.S.-based third-party digital asset-focused custodians, NYDIG Trust Company LLC ("NYDIG")

relations.text: テキサス州ロックデールの拠点で25MW(最大追加75MW)を10年間貸すデータセンター契約(2026年1月)
relations.text_en: January 2026 ten-year data center lease for 25 MW at Rockdale, with options for 75 MW more

source.label: Riot Platforms 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: in January 2026, we announced the execution of a long-term data center lease agreement (the "AMD Lease") with Advanced Micro Devices, Inc. ("AMD"), to initially provide 25 MW of critical IT load capacity at the Rockdale Facility.

relations.text: 電力・データセンター向けの電気設計会社を2024年12月に買収
relations.text_en: Acquired the electrical engineering firm serving energy developers and data centers in December 2024

source.label: Riot Platforms 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: In December 2024, we acquired E4A Solutions, a leading provider of electrical engineering services to a diverse customer base of energy developers and data center operators (the "E4A Solutions Acquisition").

companies.name: ブロック・マイニング

relations.text: ケンタッキー州のビットコイン採掘会社を2024年に買収
relations.text_en: Acquired the Kentucky bitcoin miner in 2024

source.label: Riot Platforms 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: In 2024, we acquired Block Mining in the Commonwealth of Kentucky, which also maintains a favorable regulatory environment for bitcoin mining.

relations.text: 大株主だったRiotとBitfarmsが2024年9月に和解契約を結んだ
relations.text_en: Riot, a large shareholder, signed a settlement agreement with Bitfarms in September 2024

source.label: Bitfarms 年次情報書(40-F添付、2024年度)
source.label_en: Bitfarms annual information form (40-F exhibit, FY2024)
source.quote: A Settlement Agreement dated September 23, 2024 was entered by the Company and Riot Platforms, Inc.

companies.name: アプライド・デジタル

relations.text: Applied Digitalが10-Kで、データセンター・ホスティング事業の競合としてRiotを挙げる
relations.text_en: Applied Digital names Riot as a competitor in data center hosting

source.label: Applied Digital 10-K(2025年5月期)
source.quote: Specifically, within our Data Center Hosting Business, we compete against Bitdeer Technologies Group and Riot Platforms, amongst other private operators.

companies.name: アイレン
companies.sub: ビットコイン採掘・AIクラウド

relations.text: IRENが10-Kで、ビットコイン採掘の競合の一社としてRiotを挙げる
relations.text_en: IREN names Riot among public bitcoin-mining competitors

source.label: IREN 10-K(2025年6月期)
source.quote: Several public companies (traded in the U.S. and internationally) compete with us in Bitcoin Mining, including Bitdeer Technologies Group, Bitfarms Ltd., Cipher Mining Inc., CleanSpark, Inc., Core Scientific Inc., Hut 8 Corp., MARA Holdings, Inc., Riot Platforms, Inc. and TeraWulf Inc.

relations.text: HIVEが10-Kで、競合する上場企業の一社としてRiotを挙げる
relations.text_en: HIVE names Riot among public companies it competes with

source.label: HIVE Digital 10-K(2026年3月期)
source.quote: We compete with multiple public companies, including Bitdeer Technologies Group, Keel Infrastructure Corp., Cipher Digital Inc., CleanSpark, Inc., Core Scientific Inc., Hut 8 Corp., MARA Holdings, Inc., Riot Platforms, Inc. and TeraWulf Inc.

companies.name: アルゴ・ブロックチェーン

relations.text: Argoが20-Fで、競合となりうる上場企業の一社としてRiotを挙げる
relations.text_en: Argo Blockchain names Riot among public companies that may compete with it

source.label: Argo Blockchain 20-F(2024年度)
source.quote: Several public companies (traded in the United States and internationally), including but not limited to the following, may be considered to compete with us: Bit Digital, Inc., Bitdeer Technologies Group, Bitfarms Technologies Ltd., Cipher Mining, CleanSpark Inc., Core Scientific, Inc., DMG Blockchain Solutions Inc., HIVE Blockchain Technologies Ltd, Hut 8 Mining Corp, Iris Energy Company, Marathon Digital Holdings, Inc., Northern Data AG, Riot Platforms Inc., Stronghold Digital Mining, and TeraWulf Inc.

relations.text: Solunaが10-Kで、競合しうる上場マイニング会社の筆頭にRiotを挙げる
relations.text_en: Soluna lists Riot first among public bitcoin miners it may compete with

source.label: Soluna 10-K(2024年度)
source.quote: We may compete with the following publicly traded Bitcoin mining companies: Riot Platforms, Marathon Digital Holdings, Core Scientific, Cipher Mining, Hut 8 Mining, Hive Blockchain Technologies, Bitfarms, Bitdeer Technologies Group, Cleanspark, IREN, Bit Digital, TeraWulf, and Greenidge Generation Holdings.
